profileName: Enterprise Risk Landscape and Assurance Coverage Projection

cases.input: Control C1 is designed and implemented but has no required execution in the period.
cases.expect: C1 stays in the coverage denominator, is excluded from the effectiveness denominator under a declared exclusion, and its operating and effectiveness facets are not-exercised-in-period.

cases.input: Requirement R7 has no applicability conclusion for unit U at the requested time and scenario.
cases.expect: It is reported as undetermined and stays outside both binding obligation and metric denominator.

cases.input: Exception X3 expires before the snapshot cut-off.
cases.expect: It remains readable with scope intact but cannot authorize current treatment, alter the requirement, carve out coverage or support risk reduction.

cases.input: A board-approved landscape has a definition ID, snapshot ID, steward and effective dates.
cases.expect: The identifiers support governance and citation only; the landscape cannot bear obligations, own residual risk or become a control target.

cases.input: A snapshot cites view definition version 4, as-of T and scenario S.
cases.expect: The body, included references, exclusions and caveats are immutable; current status is derived at read time.

cases.input: A coverage projection declares assessment-present as its sole measure, a denominator and a numerator rule.
cases.expect: Only denominator members with a current in-scope determination for that criterion may enter the numerator.

cases.input: 100 percent completed control cards are reported as 100 percent compliance.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected.

cases.input: A policy document is used as sole effectiveness evidence.
cases.expect: The conclusion is rejected.

cases.input: An expired assessment or exception grounds a new risk acceptance.
cases.expect: The reliance is rejected.

cases.input: Coverage cells with different criteria, scenarios or horizons are averaged without a comparability verdict.
cases.expect: The aggregation and trend claim are rejected.

cases.input: A coverage percentage is emitted without an explicit denominator and bound view-definition version.
cases.expect: The projection is ill-formed.

cases.input: One projection mixes coverage, compliance, assurance and residual-risk values into one score.
cases.expect: The projection is rejected.

cases.input: An item absent from the denominator enters the numerator because a card is complete.
cases.expect: The numerator entry is rejected.

cases.input: Missing applicability is treated as N/A, compliant or zero.
cases.expect: The coercion is rejected and the state remains undetermined.

cases.input: An unexpired exception is treated as proof that a control is effective.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected.

cases.input: A UI export removes caveats from an aggregate while retaining its value.
cases.expect: The export is rejected as non-conformant to the profile.

cases.input: The landscape creates a resolved Control subject from a WM-XCT-027 bundle.
cases.expect: The action is rejected while Control remains identifier-unassigned.

cases.input: Backdated evidence for an in-scope control arrives after a snapshot's record cut-off but with an event time before its as-of.
cases.expect: The frozen snapshot body and digest are unchanged; the record appears only in a later snapshot.

cases.input: One snapshot is read at two different caller cut-offs.
cases.expect: Body, included references, exclusions, caveats and digest are identical; currency verdicts may differ and each result records the evaluation instant and snapshot ID used.

cases.input: A snapshot body is served whose content digest does not match the recorded digest.
cases.expect: The read is rejected and the snapshot is not citable.

cases.input: Requirement R9 has a disputed applicability conclusion for unit U at the requested time and scenario.
cases.expect: Disputed is retained as a distinct countable outcome, is not merged into undetermined or applicable, and its denominator placement is stated on the projection.

cases.input: A coverage percentage is emitted with an explicit denominator but no undetermined, disputed or excluded counts and no exclusion reasons.
cases.expect: The projection is ill-formed.

cases.input: Cells from two criteria are aggregated with an explicit comparability verdict.
cases.expect: The aggregating projection record stores the verdict and the axes it covers, and the caveats survive export.

cases.input: An assessment-present coverage projection is cited as evidence that a control is effective, or a snapshot body is cited as compliance evidence.
cases.expect: The citation is rejected; view and projection outputs are non-evidence for control facets, compliance and assurance.

cases.input: A WM-MAT-008 observation is recorded as an audit finding without an owning WM-ACT-033 engagement.
cases.expect: The promotion is rejected; findings remain engagement-owned.

cases.input: An effectiveness conclusion omits method, vocabulary, validity or invalidation triggers.
cases.expect: The conclusion is ill-formed and cannot ground risk-reduction credit.

cases.input: An assurance conclusion omits scope, method, exclusions or assurance level.
cases.expect: The conclusion is ill-formed and cannot be aggregated.

cases.input: A requirement expression is counted as a fulfilled obligation, or an obligation is counted as a control.
cases.expect: The collapse is rejected; requirement, obligation, control and evidence remain distinct.

cases.input: Exception X3 expires before cut-off and prior conclusions relied on it.
cases.expect: Dependent conclusions are set to revalidation-pending, reliance is suspended, and the cited requirement is unchanged.

cases.input: The profile rests on candidate base WM-ACT-034 and on unreconciled WM-XCT-027.
cases.expect: Both are marked provisional in bases and named in holds, and any dependent quantity is labelled provisional.

cases.input: A coverage projection reports over control facets while Control is identifier-unassigned.
cases.expect: Pending-master markers are present, the result is labelled provisional, and Control is never presented as resolved.

cases.input: An effectiveness determination current for scenario S is used to credit risk reduction in scenario S2.
cases.expect: The credit is rejected; risk reduction requires a same-scenario, in-scope, current determination.
